item.title: PM Holness describes Jessie Jackson as one of the most positively consequential civil rights leaders of 20th and 21st centuries

item.title: Opposition calls on PM to clarify the status of the Morant Bay Urban Centre following reports that the centre remains incomplete
item.description: The Opposition has called on Prime Minister Dr. Andrew Holness to clarify the status of the Morant Bay Urban Centre in St. Thomas.
